# Vendored answer-me-with-html CLI

Pinned copy of the bundled `scripts/am.mjs` from
[QingYunA/answer-me-with-html](https://github.com/QingYunA/answer-me-with-html)
at commit `822d0d293217ae08b681f7b9cac94f68fc665713` (CLI version 0.4.12).

This app wraps `node scripts/am.mjs render - -o <abs.html> --no-open` as the
`am_render` tool. Do not run `am video` here. MIT license is in `LICENSE`.

See `VERSION` for the pin. Re-download `scripts/am.mjs` from that commit when
updating, then bump this file and `VERSION`.
